title: Quality Didn't Meet My Needs (Five To Ten Days)
style: indie folk pop, acoustic guitar, soft male lead, female harmonies, 88 BPM, brushed drums, melancholy, ironic, gentle, customer-feedback-loop, dropdown-menu, breakup-song
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
To help us incorporate your feedback into future improvements
Let us know why you're requesting refund movements
Quality of responses didn't meet my needs that day
Clicked the dropdown, watched the chatbot fade away

[Pre-Chorus]
Quality didn't meet my needs, the dropdown said it all
The trading bot was banned, the Pro tier hit the wall

[Chorus]
Quality didn't meet my needs, didn't meet my needs
The AI declined the use case where my whole vision feeds
Quality didn't meet my needs, didn't meet my needs
Five to ten business days for the cash to plant new seeds

[Verse 2]
Thanks, let me check whether your subscription qualifies
The checking is theatrical, the script never lies
You are eligible for a refund, the magic words drop
Now cancel the access, the loop never stops

[Bridge]
Five to ten business days, the bank has its time
The ledger sits in limbo, the chargeback feels like crime
You can always reply here if anything else comes up
The conversation has ended, the cup is in the cup

[Outro]
Quality didn't meet my needs, the dropdown made the call
Five to ten business days and the refund hits the wall
